## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue when applicable.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Include relevant regression,
permission, migration, browser or failure-recovery checks. Explain failed or
unrun checks; do not mark planned checks as passed.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to configuration, permissions, API contracts, persisted data or
agent behavior, including upgrade and rollback steps. Write "None" if unaffected.

## AI assistance

AI assistance: **yes / no**

If yes, name the tools (and models when known) and the parts they helped with.
Include design, implementation, tests, documentation and review as applicable.
Keep private prompts, transcripts and credentials out of the description.
The contributor remains responsible for the complete change. Do not name AI
tools or models as commit authors or coauthors.
